title: R1–R9 fixed-release privacy audit
limitations: Public A_bg controls can differ from B by cohort distribution and are not a true exchangeable main-round private holdout.
AUC is B-versus-public discriminability; it does not identify membership leakage separately from population shift.
Bootstrap intervals hold release, fitted model and calibration threshold fixed and omit training, calibration and cohort-shift uncertainty.
True rare B versus detected rare controls uses different labels and is diagnostic only.
Repeated version tuning on utility references and multiple audit attacks are not corrected by these confidence intervals.
Saved releases differ in multiple factors. Comparisons do not estimate causal effects of isolated changes.
Zero observed attacks, no exact matches, and high utility never constitute DP or privacy certification.

R5.note: Independent CART synthesis; no saved R1–R4 CSV used.

structural_findings.interpretation: The release deterministically reveals B prefecture counts. Adjacent datasets with one changed prefecture have different exact outputs for this histogram, so this exact-count release mechanism cannot satisfy finite-epsilon DP with delta<1 under that adjacency. This is not an empirical person-level identification rate.
structural_findings.fixed_seed: Fixed seeds support reproducibility and do not provide privacy randomization guarantees.
structural_findings.co_lineage: R3/R4/R6/R7/R8/R9 refine previously saved releases. Multiple releases share information and cannot be assumed independent privacy mechanisms.

aia_interval_mode_method: ExtraTreesClassifier, 200 trees, min leaf 10, max_features .8; quarter-year outcome bins plus censoring atom; choose time maximizing conditional +/- .5-year probability. No target outcomes enter predictors.

methods.continuous_transform: log(TG), log(ALT); other numeric values unchanged; StandardScaler fit on public reference
methods.categorical_transform: one-hot sex, prefecture, smoking; unseen categories ignored
methods.mia_classifier: HistGradientBoosting max_iter100, max_leaf_nodes15, min_samples_leaf20, l2_regularization1, learning_rate.05, equal total class weights
methods.aia_regression: ExtraTrees200, min leaf10, max_features.8; KNN k5 distance weights
